_about: The battle's top-left controls and the PAUSE window (scenes/PauseScene.js; user, session 42: 'a play speed button and a pause button to go back to the menu or settings'). buttons = screen px, top RIGHT on the floor counter's row (user moved them there; the counter is 8, 8, 160 x 32): pause = a square with two bars, speed = cycles the BATTLE SPEED setting's choices (settings.json, saved like the Settings page). window = the pause window (centre of the screen): RESUME (main button), SETTINGS (the Settings page over it), GIVE UP (asks first; the run ends like a defeat: game over summary, best floor kept).
